g.text: Isolated ground-state atom/ion: q → q + 1. Points are discrete thresholds; no interpolation.
Source: NIST ASD 5.12 • SRC-000005 • snapshot 2026-09-14. Error bars: reported uncertainty.
Small error bars may be hidden by markers. Unknown uncertainty is not zero. Not an emission spectrum.
